hint.text:
Use gerund after:
• verb/adjective/noun + preposition
• certain verbs (enjoy, avoid, regret, consider, miss, ...)
• certain phrases (instead of, have trouble, can't help)

Use infinitive after:
• adjectives and nouns
• certain verbs (decide, try, refuse, demand, pretend, ...)
• it + adjective and how (it’s important to.../he explained how to...)

instruction.text: Fill in the gap. Decide whether to use gerund or infinitive.

atoms.b: He regrets ((buying)) the concert ticket.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to regret wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.

atoms.b: She is determined ((to_become)) a lawyer despite the challenges.

feedback.wrong: Nach Adjektiven folgt der Infinitiv.

atoms.b: Many people are sceptical about ((relying)) too much on artificial intelligence.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (sceptical about) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: The engineer wanted ((to_explain)) the complex process in simple terms.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to try wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

atoms.b: The company was criticized for not ((taking)) security concerns seriously.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (criticized for) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: The activists demanded ((to_meet)) with government officials to discuss policy changes.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to demand wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

atoms.b: Instead of ((throwing)) away old clothes, you should donate them.

feedback.wrong: Die Phrase instead of wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.

atoms.b: His refusal ((to_accept)) the election results led to controversy.

feedback.wrong: Nach Nomen (refusal) folgt der Infinitiv.

atoms.b: They succeeded in ((developing)) a more eco-friendly alternative to plastic.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (succeeded in) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: They insisted on ((being)) treated fairly in the workplace.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (insisted on) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: The guide explained how ((to_behave)) appropriately in religious sites.

feedback.wrong: Das Wort how wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap. Decide whether to use gerund or infinitive.

atoms.b: He apologized for ((forgetting)) to book the hotel in advance.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (apologized for) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: Learning a new language can be challenging, but it’s rewarding ((to_communicate)) with locals in their native tongue.

feedback.wrong: Nach Adjektiven (rewarding) folgt der Infinitiv.

atoms.b: Her ambition ((to_work)) for an international company motivated him.

feedback.wrong: Nach Nomen (ambition) folgt der Infinitiv.

atoms.b: She postponed ((applying)) for college because of financial reasons.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to postpone wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.

atoms.b: Their goal is ((to_achieve)) the highest possible score.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb be wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

atoms.b: He apologized for ((deleting)) important files by accident.

feedback.wrong: Nach Verb + Präposition (apologized for) folgt das Gerundium.

atoms.b: The government needs ((to_enforce)) stricter waste management policies.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb need (to) wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.

atoms.b: They kept ((ignoring)) the warnings about rising sea levels.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to keep wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.

atoms.b: She couldn’t resist ((looking)) for handmade souvenirs from the local market.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to resist wird mit dem Gerundium verwendet.

atoms.b: They volunteered ((to_assist)) in the restoration of the historical monument.

feedback.wrong: Das Verb to volunteer wird mit dem Infinitiv verwendet.
